Use with caution / monitor [naproxen:drug_interactions:1].

Naproxen and anticoagulants such as warfarin have a synergistic effect on bleeding, leading to an increased risk of serious bleeding when used concomitantly compared to either drug alone [naproxen:drug_interactions:0]. Naproxen is classified as a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) and interacts with warfarin to increase the risk of bleeding [warfarin:drug_interactions:6, naproxen:clinical_pharmacology:0]. Patients receiving this combination should be closely monitored for signs of bleeding [naproxen:drug_interactions:1, warfarin:drug_interactions:5].
